definition: "Normalized" means dividing both query and reference by their own maximum intensity before comparing. "As is" means both keep their original values.
tolerance: All three items (top before, top after, same or not) match
issue: The question could be read as normalizing only the query. Normalizing only the query mismatches the scale with the references (maximum ~1000), making both cases give the same answer. Add "divide both the query and the references by their own maximum intensity" to the question.
replaces: The original item used cosine, but cosine is scale invariant, so the top match can never change with normalization. It only works with Euclidean distance.
